parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid is the top cover of the lighter, made of aluminum, which protects the internal components and prevents accidental ignition.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as a protective cover and helps extinguish the flame when closed by cutting off oxygen supply.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around a hinge connected to the base body, allowing it to open and close smoothly.

parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: The wheel is a small steel component located near the top of the lighter, used to generate sparks.
parts.Functional_description: It creates friction against a flint to produce sparks that ignite the fuel vapor.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates when rubbed by the thumb, generating sparks through friction.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main housing of the lighter, typically made of brass, containing the fuel reservoir and internal mechanism.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the fuel, wick, and ignition components, providing structural support and a grip surface.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the main body to hold and operate the lighter.
